name: time-machine
title: Time Machine
description: This extension is built to integrate MacOS system backup utility "TimeMachine" with Raycast. With the help of tmutil CLI Utility, it offers users the ability to control their backups with ease.
author: SuoweiHu

commands.name: cmd-start-backup
commands.title: Start Backup
commands.description: Perform a standard backup. This is equivalent to choosing "Back Up Now" from the Time Machine menu extra.

commands.name: cmd-stop-backup
commands.title: Stop Backup
commands.description: Cancel a backup currently in progress.

commands.name: cmd-list-destination
commands.title: List Backup
commands.description: Print information about destinations currently configured for use with Time Machine.

commands.name: cmd-show-status
commands.title: Show Status
commands.description: Print information about the current status of Time Machine, or the status of the most recent backup. In order to get the most recent status, full disk access is required.

commands.name: cmd-clean-snapshots
commands.title: Clean Local Snapshots
commands.description: Reclaim disk space by listing and bulk-deleting local APFS snapshots. macOS creates these when your backup disk is disconnected, silently consuming 50-200GB+ on Macs with limited storage.

preferences.name: concurrency
preferences.title: Parallel Deletion Threads
preferences.description: Number of snapshots to delete simultaneously. Higher = faster but more CPU usage.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
